limitations: All 15 unlinked AAC(6)-label terms are covered, not every source term in the enzyme family.
Unreviewed submission names and source-cited bibliography support references, not tested alleles.
Generic II, Iw-neighbor and Ib-cr entries are not exact IIa, Iw or numbered cr-subtype assignments.
Empty citation queries and missing definition citations do not establish gene or protein absence.
The AAC29 primary PDF request was held after a 403 challenge; no retry or alternative was used.
The AAC34 table reports a heterologous host and an ambiguous compound label, not native-isolate MIC.
No strain, construct, sequence, variant, protocol or new experimental genome identity is exported.
Two new reference links await reconciliation into a successor broad index.
